BRANCH: Management  SESSION: MO/2025

SUBJECT: MN431 MOBILE AND EMAIL MARKETING
TIME: 02 Hours  FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1 Explain the  importance  of  app  stores  in  mobile  marketing. A start-up  is  planning  a
mobile-first product launch. What mobile marketing mix would you recommend?
[5] 1 2,3


Q.2. Differentiate  between  mobile  marketing  and  traditional  marketing.  Discuss  the  key
features of major Instant messaging apps.
[2+3] 1 2


Q.3 What are pull based and push based messaging. A restaurant chain plans to use SMS
and  push  notifications  to  promote  limited  time  offer. How  would  you  ensure  these
messages are effective without annoying customers?
5 2 2,3


Q.4 What  are  the  ways  through  which  companies  can  publish  mobile  friendly  content?
Discuss the growing importance of social media advertising.
[2+3] 2 2,3


Q.5 A start-up wants to launch its first product through a cost-effective campaign. Evaluate
how email marketing tools can be used for designing, scheduling, and tracking email
campaigns,  and  explain  why  they  may  be  more  effective  compared  to  traditional
marketing methods.
5 3 4
